title: Speakman S-1496-AF Sentinel Mark II Exposed Shower

comparisons.notes: Same model S-1496-AF, chrome, in stock
Same model S-1496-AF rough chrome, in stock

writeup: Speakman's S-1496-AF Sentinel Mark II exposed anti-scald shower is $145.99 new on Woot, while Ferguson and The Builders Supply list it at $294.34. It's a commercial-grade cast brass pressure-balanced unit with an adjustable temperature limit stop, gooseneck, and the S-2272-E2 showerhead included.
